description: This is a test class for the RabbitMQClientActor in a Java project. It contains unit tests for the messaging client actor that interacts with RabbitMQ, including connection handling, reconnections, and message processing.

classes.name: RabbitMQClientActorTest
classes.description: A test suite for the RabbitMQClientActor, testing connection handling, message processing, reconnection logic, and error scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and connection object before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Preparatory setup before each test, mocking connection factory behaviors.

methods.name: invalidTargetFormatThrowsConnectionConfigurationInvalidException
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid target formats leading to configuration exceptions.

methods.name: testExceptionDuringConnectionFactoryCreation
methods.description: Checks behavior when the connection factory creation throws an exception.

methods.name: testConnectionHandling
methods.description: Verifies basic connect and disconnect flows.

methods.name: testReconnectionHandling
methods.description: Simulates a connection loss and verifies reconnection and message processing after reconnect.

methods.name: verifyPublishOnChannel
methods.description: Helper method to verify message publish calls on a mock channel.

methods.name: sendOutboundSignal
methods.description: Helper method to send an outbound signal message to the actor.

methods.name: sendInboundModifyThingProtocolMessage
methods.description: Helper method to simulate an inbound message delivery to the consumer.

methods.name: testConnectionWithoutPublisherHandling
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the connection has no targets and thus no publisher is created.

methods.name: testReconnection
methods.description: Performs multiple connect/disconnect cycles to test reconnection robustness.

methods.name: sendCommandDuringInit
methods.description: Tests sending a command during actor initialization.

methods.name: sendConnectCommandWhenAlreadyConnected
methods.description: Ensures that repeated connect commands don't cause errors.

methods.name: sendDisconnectWhenAlreadyDisconnected
methods.description: Ensures disconnect commands when already disconnected are handled gracefully.

methods.name: testCloseConnectionFails
methods.description: Checks behavior for closing connection after it has been opened.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a connection object, optionally using secure scheme.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates and returns Props for the RabbitMQClientActor with test configuration.

methods.name: getClientActorProps
methods.description: Helper to assemble Props for the test actor with mocked dependencies.

methods.name: getActorSystem
methods.description: Returns the ActorSystem used in tests.
